params.value: ($1), who needs the tutorial? Click on the players or select from the middle.

preset.text:
Every round, you will see a prompt with a blank space (e.g., 'Hot _____'). Type a word to fill in the blank.

If your word matches EXACTLY ONE other player's word, you both get 3 points! If it matches more than one player, you all get 1 point. If it matches nobody, you get 0 points.

Play smart and try to form pairs!
